open_points.subject: configuration and credential path traversal
open_points.text: “empty and `.` components are skipped” says nothing about a `..` component
open_points.question: When the component-by-component opener encounters `..`, must it reject the path or traverse to the parent directory?
options: open `..` relative to the current directory descriptor

open_points.subject: post-start SQLite symbolic links
open_points.text: “The database file and its journal are opened by SQLite ... the kernel does not watch them after it” contradicts “symlink_inside(data_directory) -> refused”
open_points.question: Does a database or journal symbolic link introduced after startup remain permitted to SQLite, or must the kernel detect it and refuse the operation?
options: the stated SQLite exception wins and post-start links for those files are not refused
the formal invariant wins and every post-start symbolic link is refused
limit the invariant explicitly to files opened by the store itself

open_points.subject: SQLite files exempt from post-start no-follow checks
open_points.text: “The database file and its journal are opened by SQLite” does not identify which SQLite auxiliary files count as “its journal”
open_points.question: Which SQLite-opened files are covered by the exception, and is SQLite required to use a particular journal and temporary-file mode?
options: only the main database and rollback-journal file, with SQLite configured accordingly
the main database plus every SQLite sidecar such as rollback journal, WAL, shared-memory and super-journal files
every file SQLite may open, including temporary files
open_points.default_guess: configure SQLite to use a rollback journal and treat only the main database and rollback-journal file as exempt
